Installation Guide

First, ensure that the Jetson Orin Nano has been properly setup by following the configuration guide <jetson_config>.

Next, follow the ROS2 Humble Install Guide to get ROS2 setup on the Jetson Orin Nano.

Then run the following:

$ cd ~/

$ git clone https://github.com/shouvik-d/roboflock_ws.git

$ cd ~/roboflock_ws

$ rosdep install --from-paths src -y --ignore-src

$ colcon build

$ source install/bin/setup.bash

Check out Managing USB Devices to get all USB devices ready for use and run through the remaining configuration guides for all other components (GPS modules, motor drivers, etc.).
